question: Where is Salim Ali National Park located in India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Srinagar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Salim Ali National Park **is a beautiful place, located in the **Srinagar district** of the state **of Jammu and Kashmir.**
 
• The park is also known as** City Forest National Park.**
 
• The total area of this national park is about 9 km2, and it was named in **honour of Salim Ali, **the famous Indian ornithologist (famous naturalist and bird watcher of India).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The park featured wildlife species such as the hangul, musk deer, Himalayan black bear, leopard, Himalayan serow and 70 species of birds, including the Himalayan snowcock.
 
• 
 **The Salim Ali National Park was named so officially** in the year 1986.
